## Knowledge Graph

The Paddle Board Overstock knowledge graph organizes water sports equipment as an ontology of categories, technologies, and use cases.

### Core Concepts

- Inflatable SUP Board: Portable air-filled paddle board designed for surfing, touring, and recreation on flat water and small waves
- Safety Equipment: Life vests, leashes, throw bags, and safety accessories for recreational paddle boarding
- Accessories: Pumps, paddles, fins, repair kits, and carrying bags that complete the inflatable SUP setup
- Paddle: Manual propulsion tool used with inflatable SUP boards
- Carbon Fiber Paddle: Lightweight, high-performance paddle made from carbon fiber composite for reduced fatigue during long sessions
- Drop-Stitch Core: Connects thousands of polyester threads between top and bottom layers to achieve rigid platform shape under high inflation pressure
- Dual-Action Pump: Hand pump that inflates on both up and down strokes for faster, more efficient inflation of inflatable SUP boards
- High Pressure (12-15 PSI): Optimal inflation range that maximizes board rigidity while remaining within safe operating limits for drop-stitch construction
- Marine-Grade PVC: High-density PVC fabric with UV-resistant coating used for durable inflatable SUP board construction
- EVA Foam Deck Pad: Non-slip, shock-absorbing foam deck covering that provides traction and comfort for stand-up paddle boards
- Carbon Fiber: Lightweight, high-strength composite material used in paddles and performance paddle boarding equipment
- Marine Buoyancy Foam: Closed-cell foam that provides permanent flotation for life vests and safety equipment in fresh and salt water
- Touring & Distance Paddling: Extended paddling trips covering significant distance on lakes, rivers, and coastal waters
- Beginner: First-time paddlers learning the basics of inflatable SUP boards, safety, and water navigation
- SUP Fishing: Using a stable inflatable SUP as a portable casting platform for lake, river, and inshore fishing
- Family Recreation: Inflatable SUP boards used for casual family outings on lakes, gentle rivers, and protected coastal waters
- River Touring: Navigating rivers with current, from gentle Class I stretches to more challenging Class II rapids

### Relations

- SUP boards are used for touring and distance paddling
- Inflatable SUPs are ideal for beginners due to stability
- Inflatable SUPs are used for river touring
- Stable inflatable SUPs are a popular platform for fishing
- Wide, stable SUP boards suit family recreation
- Safety equipment is essential for all water activities
- Drop-stitch core is the primary construction method for rigid SUPs
- EVA foam deck pads provide traction on SUP boards
- Dual-action pumps are the standard inflation tool for SUPs
- Carbon fiber paddles reduce fatigue on long touring sessions
- Carbon fiber paddles are lighter and stiffer than standard aluminum paddles

The Paddle Board Overstock knowledge graph organizes water sports equipment as an ontology of categories, technologies, and use cases.

### Core Concepts

- Inflatable SUP Board: Portable air-filled paddle board designed for surfing, touring, and recreation on flat water and small waves
